messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D lesbian dating visual novel set in an old Western town, featuring multiple romance routes and choices.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks (viewport at most 1280px wide); read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Created a frontier romance game, *Dust & Devotion*, with three adult character routes, choice-driven outcomes, boundaries and consent themes, and a 3D Three.js town scene.

## Work State

### Completed
- Added the game UI and responsive styling in `index.html` and `style.css`.
- Added Three.js town and character scene, dialogue routes, choices, journal, and endings in `game.js`.

### Active
- Fix and verify the game in-browser; initial browser load exposed `ReferenceError: $ is not defined` in `game.js`.
- The file was subsequently rewritten and patched, but the corrected version has not yet been syntax-checked or tested in-browser.

### Blocked
- Browser verification was interrupted by the code fix; no screenshot has been captured.

## Next Move
1. Run `node --input-type=module --check < game.js`.
2. Reload `http://localhost:3002` with `playwright-cli`, check console, and play through choices and an ending.
3. Save and inspect a current small JPEG screenshot; fix any issues found.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game interface and UI elements.
- `style.css`: Visual design and responsive layouts.
- `game.js`: Three.js scene and gameplay logic.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A local server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`; browser session opened at `http://localhost:3002`.
- The last observed browser error was `ReferenceError: $ is not defined` at `game.js:51`; the old version used `$` before declaring it. The game script was then rewritten with `$` declared near the top and gameplay code appended, but this fix remains unverified.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D lesbian dating visual novel set in an old Western town, with multiple romance routes and choices.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks (viewport at most 1280px wide); read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Created *Dust & Devotion*, a frontier romance with three adult women, choice-driven outcomes, consent and boundaries themes, and a Three.js town scene.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added responsive game UI and styling in `index.html` and `style.css`.
- Added Three.js town and character scene, three routes, choices, journal, and endings in `game.js`.
- Fixed the `$ is not defined` script issue; `node --input-type=module --check < game.js` passes.
- Loaded the game at `http://localhost:3002`; browser console reported zero errors.
- Captured and inspected the latest small JPEG screenshot at `screenshots/current.jpg`.

### Active
- Play through route choices to verify the game reaches an ending; browser verification so far checked the title screen only.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Play through a route in the browser, checking choices, journal, and ending behavior.
2. Capture and inspect a new screenshot after gameplay; report any issues found.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game interface and controls.
- `style.css`: Visual design and responsive layouts.
- `game.js`: Three.js scene, story routes, choices, journal, and endings.
- `screenshots/current.jpg`: Latest inspected screenshot of the title screen.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Local server is running at `http://localhost:3002`.
- Playwright browser is open on the game; console has 0 errors.
